limitations: The probe exercises the production routeProtectionRequest helper and ProtectionPageContextStore in a minimal Electron host, not the full Intoponet UI, shield controls, persistence, or private-session UX.

For requests without a WebContents ID, a known initiator origin is used for first-party and site-pause scope. Without an initiator, only destination host rules can be applied; no top-level site exception or per-tab count is available.
This probe covers these local fixture paths only. It does not prove all service-worker, redirect, subframe, WebSocket, DNS, TLS, or Chromium-internal requests pass through Electron webRequest.
The ruleset is a small local fixture, not EasyList/EasyPrivacy and not malware or phishing protection.
The hidden-window test verifies interception and page execution, not visible compositing or accessibility.
